about: The Workbench icons of the Xpired drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/xpired.png is four of X-pired's own tiles (img/crate.bmp, explosive.bmp, barel.bmp and exit.bmp, GPL 2 like the game) on a 64 x 64 grid. Xpired-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, put beside the drawer as Xpired.info; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Xpired.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for X-pired.txt and COPYING.txt.
